name: Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning
aliases: Multi-view Alphabased Densification and Pruning strategy
definition: A strategy to address excessive Gaussian production and overfitting in single-view gradient-based densification by leveraging multi-view guidance.
summary: Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning is a 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization that uses multi-view consistency metrics to control Gaussian count and prevent overfitting.
